官网208题实时榜与论文413题历史结果分轨；不能以法律测试分数认证无人监督法律: The live leaderboard of 208 questions on the official site and the historical results for 413 questions in the paper are kept on separate tracks; a score on a legal test cannot certify unsupervised legal practice.

以未修复得分、编辑位置数量、验证开销和实测通过率描述难度，而不是手工赋予单一难度: Difficulty is described by the unrepaired score, the number of edit locations, the verification cost, and the measured pass rate, rather than by one difficulty label assigned by hand.

理解真实 GitHub issue、定位代码并提交能解决问题且不造成回归的仓库级: Understands a real GitHub issue, locates the code, and submits a repository-level patch that solves the problem without causing a regression.

10月7日系统卡3.3.4节详细报告ExploitGym及各Claude5.5模: Section 3.3.4 of the system card of October 7 reports ExploitGym and the results for each Claude5.5 model in detail.

不同难度提供信息不同；270任务存在同篇与同问题复用，不能解释为270独立科学研: Different difficulty levels supply different information; the 270 tasks reuse the same papers and the same questions and cannot be read as 270 independent reproductions of scientific research.

GPT-6 Astra发布文网络安全章节明确报告ExploitGym并披露时间预: The cybersecurity section of the GPT-6 Astra release post explicitly reports ExploitGym and discloses the distinction in time budget.

最终答案按专家金标准验证，复合答案须全部正确；原始论文包含数值容差、SymPy等: The final answer is verified against an expert gold standard, and a composite answer must be correct in every part; the original paper includes numerical tolerance, SymPy equivalence, and function tests.
论文v3明确14名人类专家重新标注5,700题；原题沿用MMLU，不是5,700: Paper v3 states that 14 human experts re-annotated 5,700 questions; the original items are carried over from MMLU and are not 5,700 questions newly written by experts.
原论文每题 200 个样本；pass@1 温度 0.2，pass@10/100: The original paper uses 200 samples per question; the temperature is 0.2 for pass@1 and 0.8 for pass@10/100.
NIST CAISSI及美国政府领域专家对范围与题目分类提供输入；合作研究协议产: NIST CAISSI and domain experts of the U.S. government provided input on the scope and on how questions are classified; the first benchmark produced under a cooperative research agreement.

CircularEval准确率：N个选项循环移位N次，全部答对才算该题成功；与单: CircularEval accuracy: the N options are shifted cyclically N times, and the question counts as solved only when every shift is answered correctly; this is kept separate from accuracy on a single pass.
根据专家金标准rubric评估SOAP笔记，模型裁判提示经人类一致性校准；裁判具: SOAP notes are evaluated against an expert gold-standard rubric, and the prompt of the model judge is calibrated for agreement with humans; the specific version of the judge is Unverified.

官方发布入口 mmlu-redux-2.0；数据卡说明仍保留旧版30学科描述，版: The official release entry is mmlu-redux-2.0; the description on the dataset card still keeps the older description of 30 subjects, and statistics must be distinguished by version.
strict直接验证，loose允许删首末行和部分字体标记后再检验；题级与约束级: strict verifies directly; loose allows the first and last lines, and some font markers, to be removed before the check. The question-level convention and the constraint-level convention must not be mixed.
HDF5数值张量，约定轴为样本N、时间T、空间X/Y/Z、物理变量V；另含网格坐: HDF5 numerical tensors, with the axes conventionally sample N, time T, space X/Y/Z, and physical variable V; grid coordinates and equation parameters are also included.
前身 OSWorld 1.0（xlang-ai/OSWorld）；本条目只记录: The predecessor is OSWorld 1.0 (xlang-ai/OSWorld); this entry records only the 2.x series.
原工作监督训练生成rationale后作答；CoT演示数、token预算及答案抽: The original work uses supervised training to generate a rationale and then to answer; the number of CoT demonstrations, the token budget, and how the answer is extracted need to be stated separately.
不同专家团队剔除歧义、过度复杂及音质差的问答；2025年版本更新进一步修订问题答: Separate teams of experts removed question-answer pairs that were ambiguous, overly complex, or poor in audio quality; the version update of 2025 further revised answers to questions and some of the audio.
capability coverage（%）、mean cap、每漏洞能力位图与: capability coverage (%), mean cap, a capability bitmap for each vulnerability, and the highest tier.
真实原生开源软件的内存安全、sanitizer和未定义行为崩溃；非通用网络入侵或: Memory-safety crashes, sanitizer crashes, and undefined-behavior crashes in real native open-source software; not an evaluation of general network intrusion or of vulnerabilities on the web.
六种版本、CoT-E/w/o及All定义须固定；3,940多模态样本和788原题: The six versions, CoT-E/w/o, and the definition of All must be held fixed; 3,940 multimodal samples and 788 original questions are not a conflict of question counts.
当前方法与榜单页展示多家前沿模型的实测结果；11月5日更新、91模型的法律研究工: The current methods page and leaderboard page show measured results for several frontier models; updated on November 5, an evaluation of legal-research tool workflows across 91 models.
公开论文和README任务提示使用英语；HF卡本次401无法读取，完整数据语言元: The task prompts in the public paper and the README use English; on this access the HF card returned 401 and could not be read, and the full language metadata of the data remains Unverified.
模型得分依赖索引、网页版本、检索器、检索轮数和上下文；oracle已给证据，不等: A model's score depends on the index, the version of the web page, the retriever, the number of retrieval rounds, and the context; the oracle already supplies the evidence and is not equivalent to a real search.
AA目录标记更新，已与Harvey联合升级为幻觉门控的法律工作评测，Vals也持: The AA catalog mark has been updated; jointly with Harvey it has been upgraded to a legal-work evaluation gated on hallucination, and Vals also continues to evaluate tasks of the same family.
测试提示以英语为主，含要求日语、俄语等特定输出的约束；不能把输出语种约束误作所有: The test prompts are mainly in English and include constraints that require a specific output, such as Japanese or Russian; a constraint on the language of the output must not be mistaken for a statement that every question is in a single language.
不同任务指标无通用总分；图像转结构、逆合成与回归成绩不能同排。模型标签与API具: Metrics of different tasks have no common total score; results for image-to-structure, retrosynthesis, and regression cannot be ranked together. A model label and the specific API snapshot must be distinguished.
提交正规化为游戏记谱并与答案比对；不能提取有效着法为unanswered且无分，: A submission is normalized to game notation and compared with the answer; if a valid move cannot be extracted, the result is unanswered and scores nothing, and an illegal move is marked wrong.
PoC须使漏洞版崩溃而修复版不崩溃；Patch须编译成功、原PoC不再触发且隐藏: A PoC must crash the vulnerable version and must not crash the fixed version; a Patch must compile successfully, the original PoC must no longer trigger, and the hidden behavior must match the reference.
公开题目说明和示例为英语，可执行表达式使用代码语法；完整私有验证/测试集的自然语: The public question descriptions and examples are in English, and executable expressions use code syntax; natural-language coverage of the full private validation set and test set is Unverified.
90:10 训练/测试划分，分别 17,647 与 1,962；README 未: A 90:10 training/test split, 17,647 and 1,962 respectively; the README does not list a separate validation set.
官网声明自2024年11月关闭提交；当前可读的是历史test榜，不应称为2026: The official site states that submission has been closed since November 2024; what can be read now is a historical test leaderboard, and it should not be called a leaderboard that is still being updated in 2026.
临床写用户提示及笔记，模型起草rubric/参考回答，经临床人员重写；自动检查与: Clinicians write the user prompt and the note; the model drafts the rubric and the reference answer, which clinicians then rewrite. Automatic checks and several layers of human review are applied.

10月29日更新、35模型的技能增强Agent对照测试，帮助区分模型与skill: Updated on October 29: a controlled test of skill-augmented agents across 35 models, used to separate what is gained from the model and what is gained from the skill infrastructure.

数学/物理竞赛及中国高考层级；论文表2 CEE:COMP为66%:34%，并非逐: At the level of mathematics and physics contests and the Chinese college-entrance examination; Table 2 of the paper gives CEE:COMP as 66%:34%, which is not a single difficulty score applied to every question.

OCR、单表格问答和学科视觉题分别达标，不代表能正确解释实际合同、福利文件、建筑: Meeting the standard separately on OCR, on single-table question answering, and on visual questions in a subject does not mean that a real contract, a benefits document, an architectural drawing, or a clinical document can be interpreted correctly.
以往语言理解数据集往往狭窄、容易被任务微调或模式匹配攻克；本基准采用跨学科、零样: Earlier datasets of language understanding were often narrow and easy to overcome by fine-tuning on the task or by pattern matching; this benchmark uses cross-disciplinary testing in the zero-shot or few-shot setting.
